title: rclpy subscriptions created in a loop all report the last topic: lambda late binding, functools.partial, unstored rclcpp subscriptions and destroy_subscription, measured
excerpt: Three rclpy subscriptions made in a loop with a plain lambda received all 60 messages but labeled every one with the last topic. Default arguments, functools.partial and a factory fixed it 60/60. Unstored rclcpp subscriptions got 0. Unsubscribing compared. Humble, Jazzy, Lyrical.
